issues: 没有导出时长常量，工作台按 default 150f 渲染，末次落地 f125 后只剩 25f，不够 md 要求的 35f 真静止
顶栏是 2px 灰边 + 深灰方块 + 灰条 + 灰圆的骨架占位
接触阴影是纯黑 0.9 浓度的径向椭圆，静置时像一道脏黑边
被点名的卡与另外两张没有任何主次区分，悬停 18f 完全静止像卡帧
changes: 补导出 CONTACT_SHADOW_LIFT_DURATION = 160：三次点名 f2/42/82，末次 f125 落定后真静止 35f
顶栏换成出版级产品顶栏：渐变字标 + Northwind + 导航（当前项高亮）+ 搜索框（⌘K）+ 首字母头像，毛玻璃白 + 发丝底线
接触影拆成两层带色相的径向椭圆：实心接触核（仍按 scale 1→1.72 / opacity 0.55→0.18）+ 更宽更虚的环境影，核心浓度降到 0.6 不再发脏
被点名的卡抬起时出现强调色 1.5px 发丝描边 + 极淡外环，其余两张同步 multiply 压暗约 4% 让位；悬停段加 ±1.5px 正弦漂浮（两端为 0，不动落点）
柔光浅底 + 暗角 + 颗粒；抬升 −28px / scale 1.08 / 落地 0.99 卡壳等判例参数全部保持
issuesEn: No exported duration, so the workbench used the 150f default, leaving only 25f after the last landing at f125 instead of the 35f true hold
The top bar was a skeleton: 2px grey border, a dark square, grey bars and a grey circle
The contact shadow was a pure-black 0.9 radial ellipse that read as a dirty black edge at rest
The called-out card had no hierarchy over the other two, and the 18f hover was completely frozen
Flat grey background with no light
changesEn: Exported CONTACT_SHADOW_LIFT_DURATION = 160: call-outs at f2/42/82, last landing at f125, then a 35f true hold
Top bar is a publication-grade product header: gradient logo mark, Northwind wordmark, nav with active item, ⌘K search field and initials avatar, frosted white with a hairline
Contact shadow is two tinted radial ellipses: a solid contact core (still scale 1→1.72 / opacity 0.55→0.18) plus a wider soft ambient layer, core density lowered to 0.6 so it no longer looks dirty
The lifted card gets a 1.5px accent hairline and faint outer ring while the other two dim ~4% via multiply; the hover adds a ±1.5px sine float that is zero at both ends so landings are unchanged
Soft-lit light backdrop with vignette and grain; the −28px / 1.08 lift and 0.99 landing squash precedents are untouched
